correctness.rationale: For unsigned incidence B, BᵀB=2I+A(L(H)), so -2 flat band is ker B. For each root edge e, alternating ±1 vectors on two 4-cycles meeting only at e both lie in ker B, norm 2, and their entrywise product is ±unit_e. With symmetric orthogonal P, zᵀ(P∘P)z=tr((P diag(z)P)^2)=||P diag(z)P||_F². Pairing that compression against the two cycle vectors gives |z_e|≤4||P diag(z)P||_F, yielding the universal 1/(16m) Loewner bound. Time-average spectral identity is Σ_θ E_θ∘E_θ, so additional bands only add PSD matrices. For three-factor Cartesian products, use distinct other coordinate directions to create the required squares; no isolated factor vertices. Independent exact rational Q3 projector/Schur check gave strictly positive gap; Q2 spectral decomposition yields rank 2. Finite checks are corroboration; the compression argument establishes all eligible graphs.

value.rationale: A graph-local sufficient condition for a global positive-definite quantum mixing invariant, with a dimension-uniform explicit quantitative eigenvalue bound and a natural binary hypercube cutoff. Identifies a structural fact beyond known formulas and does not conflate failure of sufficient criterion with singularity.

final_claim: For every finite unweighted simple root graph H with m edges such that each edge is the only common edge of two 4-cycles, its line-graph infinite-time continuous-time quantum average mixing matrix dominates P∘P≥I/(16m), P the projector onto the adjacency -2 flat band. Thus full-rank mixing for Cartesian products of >=3 no-isolate factors including L(Q_d), d>=3, whereas L(Q_2)=C4 has rank two.
